Expression:
VAR _country = dim_geography[Country]
RETURN
    IF(
        dim_geography[IsUK] = 1, "UK",
        SWITCH(
            _country,
            "Netherlands", "Netherlands",
            "Ireland", "Ireland",
            "Germany", "Germany",
            "France", "France",
            "Australia", "Australia",
            "Others"
        )
    )

SWITCH(
        [CustomerTypeFilter],
        "All Customers", "All Segments",
        "Registered Only", "Registered Customers",
        "Guest Only", "Guest Customers"
    )
